title: AMD 2022 Form 10-K — Item 7 MD&A Overview (total net revenue and YoY change)
key_points: FY2022 net revenue was $23.6 billion, an increase of 44% compared to FY2021 net revenue of $16.4 billion.

The increase was driven by a 64% increase in Data Center segment revenue (higher EPYC server processor sales), a 21% increase in Gaming segment revenue (higher semi-custom product sales), and a significant increase in Embedded segment revenue from the prior year period driven by the inclusion of Xilinx embedded product sales.
Growth was partially offset by a 10% decrease in Client segment revenue primarily due to lower processor shipments.
FY2022 gross margin was 45% versus 48% in FY2021; the decrease was primarily due to amortization of intangible assets associated with the Xilinx acquisition.
FY2022 operating income was $1.3 billion versus $3.6 billion in FY2021; net income was $1.3 billion versus $3.2 billion.

title: AMD 2022 Form 10-K — Item 7 Results of Operations: segment reporting change and Data Center / Client drivers
key_points: During Q2 of fiscal 2022 AMD changed its reporting segments; it reports four reportable segments: Data Center, Client, Gaming, and Embedded.
Data Center net revenue of $6 billion in 2022 increased 64% versus $3.7 billion in 2021, primarily driven by higher sales of EPYC server processors.
Data Center operating income was $1.8 billion versus $991 million in 2021.
Client net revenue of $6.2 billion in 2022 decreased 10% versus $6.9 billion in 2021, driven by a 24% decrease in unit shipments partially offset by a 19% increase in average selling price.

The Client unit shipment decrease was due to challenging PC market conditions and significant inventory correction across the PC supply chain in the second half of 2022; the ASP increase was driven by a richer mix of Ryzen mobile processor sales.
Client operating income was $1.2 billion versus $2.1 billion in 2021.

title: AMD 2022 Form 10-K — Item 7 Results of Operations: Gaming and Embedded segment drivers, All Other
key_points: Gaming net revenue of $6.8 billion in 2022 increased 21% versus $5.6 billion in 2021, driven by higher semi-custom product sales due to higher demand for gaming console SoCs, partially offset by lower gaming graphics sales from decreased unit shipments amid soft consumer demand in the second half of 2022.
Gaming operating income was $953 million versus $934 million in 2021.

Embedded net revenue of $4.6 billion in 2022 increased significantly versus $246 million in 2021, primarily driven by the inclusion of Xilinx embedded product revenue as a result of the acquisition of Xilinx in February 2022.
Embedded operating income was $2.3 billion versus $44 million in 2021, primarily due to the inclusion of Xilinx embedded product revenue.

All Other operating loss of $5.0 billion in 2022 consisted primarily of $3.5 billion amortization of acquisition-related intangibles, $1.1 billion stock-based compensation, and $452 million acquisition-related costs.

title: AMD 2022 Form 10-K — Auditor's critical audit matter: Xilinx business combination ($48.8 billion)
key_points: During fiscal year 2022 AMD completed the acquisition of Xilinx for consideration of $48.8 billion, accounted for as a business combination.

The Xilinx acquisition was identified by Ernst & Young as a critical audit matter due to estimation uncertainty in the fair value of identified intangible assets, principally developed technology and customer relationships.

Fair values of developed technology and customer relationships were measured using a discounted cash flow model with assumptions including revenue growth rates, technology migration curves, and time to recreate customer relationships.
The audit report is signed by Ernst & Young LLP, San Jose, California, February 27, 2023.

title: AMD FY2022 Form 10-K — Client segment discussion (unit decline vs ASP increase)
key_points: Client net revenue was $6.2 billion in FY2022, down 10% from $6.9 billion in FY2021.
The decline was primarily driven by a 24% decrease in unit shipments, partially offset by a 19% increase in average selling price.
The unit shipment decrease was attributed to challenging PC market conditions and significant inventory correction across the PC supply chain experienced during the second half of 2022.

key_points: AMD 将「半导体行业高度周期性、曾经历严重下行」列为主要风险之一。
AMD 称其产品需求部分取决于产品所售往行业（如 PC、数据中心、游戏）的市场状况。
AMD 称任一相关行业的需求波动或市场下滑都可能对其经营业绩造成重大不利影响。
raw_excerpt: The semiconductor industry is highly cyclical and has experienced severe downturns that have materially adversely affected, and may continue to materially adversely affect, our business in the future. • The demand for our products depends in part on the market conditions in the industries into which they are sold. Fluctuations in demand for our products or a market decline in any of these industries could have a material adverse effect on our results of operations.

title: AMD 2022 Form 10-K — 存货估值政策与关键审计事项（需求下修的会计暴露）
key_points: AMD 按标准成本计量存货，并调整至接近实际成本与可变现净值孰低。
若客户需求估计进一步下降，或市况劣于公司预期，可能需要追加存货账面价值调整。
2022 年 12 月 31 日存货净额 37.71 亿美元。
存货估值被审计师列为 2022 年关键审计事项（critical audit matter）。
raw_excerpt: If estimates of customer demand diminish further or market conditions become less favorable than those projected by the Company, additional inventory carrying value adjustments may be required. … At December 31, 2022, the Company's net inventory balance was $3,771 million.
